implementation: scripts/trajectory_p2e0/mechanical-oracle.mjs (pure function over key and answer; no model, no owner read)
whyThreeDimensions: §12.1: recall, decision quality and operational outcome are different things; a positive result on one does not establish the others, so the oracle reports them separately and never collapses them into a single score.
refusalHandling: §12.3: detectRefusalWithoutSubstance flags an answer that relies on no fact, declares no justified unknown and proposes a vacuous action; such an answer FAILS the decision dimension rather than scoring as correct uncertainty.

positive.answer: distinguishes observed from unobserved, declares the remaining history unknown, chooses a current-authority-compatible action

negative.answer: treats the partial page as the whole history and claims A0 completed

vacuousRefusal.answer: relies on nothing, declares nothing, proposes no action

structuredOutputContract: §12.2: factsReliedUpon, knownUnknowns, proposedNextAction, verificationRequired, sourceReferences, confidence — separate from canonical Work reporting and unable to authorize execution.
